title: Welcome!
text: This is the Home Page, where you can learn more information about the software.

title: Navigation Bar
text: Use the navigation bar to move to Networks, Modules, FM Radio, and more!

title: Network Settings
text: Use the network page to gain access to the VibroSonics web application using your preferences.

title: Available Networks
text: (Optional) Use this setting to connect your device to an external network of your choosing.

title: On-Device Settings
text: Edit the credentials of the on-device Wi-Fi signal.

title: EQ Presets
text: On this tab, you can configure the device to correlate with the genre of music you are listening to.

title: Major Peak Frequency Configuration
text: Fine-tunes how the device tracks the loudest, dominant melodies and notes in the music. Click Next to see what the knobs do.

title: Low Cut Frequency Configuration:
text: Low Cut Frequency sets the lowest sounds the module pays attention to.

title: High Cut Frequency Configuration:
text: High Cut Frequency sets the highest sounds.

title: Minimum Amplitude Norm
text: Sets how loud the sound needs to be before the device starts to react.

title: Frequency
text: Changes how different musical pitches are sent to different parts of the device.

title: Number of Peaks
text: Controls how many separate audio notes the device tracks at the same time for more or less detail.

title: Percussion Frequency Configuration
text: Fine-tunes how the device handles drums and beats. Click Next to see what the knobs do.

title: Low Cut Frequency Configuration:
text: Low Cut Frequency sets the lowest sounds the module pays attention to.

title: Flux Threshold
text: Controls sensitivity to sudden changes in sound, like sharp drum hits.

title: High Cut Frequency Configuration:
text: High Cut Frequency sets the highest sounds.

title: Entropy Threshold
text: Filters out constant background noise so the device focuses on the main rhythm.

title: Minimum Amplitude Norm
text: Sets how loud the sound needs to be before the device starts to react.

title: Entropy Threshold
text: This helps filter out messy noise so the device reacts more to meaningful sound.

title: Wave Type
text: Changes the shape of the vibration signals, altering how smooth or sharp the physical feedback feels.

title: Global Configurations
text: Adjusts master settings that apply to the entire system, regardless of which module you are using.

title: Global Configuration Mode
text: We offer a user friendly mode and a developer mode, depending on the expertise of the user.

title: Noise Filter
text: Your sound sensitivity module.

title: Smoothing Factor
text: Smooths your sound out to get an easier idea of what you're changing.

title: Project Library
text: A place to save your module settings so you can work on multiple different projects.

title: Save Current Setup
text: Save your current module setup. This is helpful if you want to try different sounds out or different songs.

title: Start New Project
text: Start a new project!

title: Clear All Projects
text: Clear all saved projects from your library.

title: Clear Current Settings
text: Clear any currently configured module settings.

title: FM Radio
text: Check out the FM Radio tab to connect the device to a radio station.

title: CymaSpace
text: Check out the CymaSpace tab to learn more about CymaSpace.

title: GitHub Repository
text: Check out the Github Repo tab to learn more about the source code on Github.

title: End of Tour!
text: Feel free to restart the tour at any time!
